novelty_scope: 424-file pinned repository and 13 complete recovered unlettered/B–M reports; Screens N–Q remain unrecovered. Scoped new exact therapeutic uses, not global scientific novelty.
financial_ev: No priced, obtainable development commitment has been established superior to cash. Relative financial EV is unresolved; no numerical probability or investment return is assigned.
activity: Public-source research and repository edits only; no outreach, purchases, recruitment, experiments, simulations, material receipt or monitoring automation.
counting_rule: FD-2 is the selected peptide record; FD-1 is a required within-family comparator, not a fourth retained candidate. CuNC@HisAc/HisAcAsc variants belong to one formulation-family record pending exact-product selection. Paper, patent, preprint and repository copies are not independent studies.
rank_meaning: Qualitative order for bounded public-document and existing-data gates. This is not a financial EV ranking or an automatic displacement of a defined biological qualification option.

cross_portfolio_decision.next_desktop_increment: Prefer the finite FD-2 article/patent/product reconciliation over reopening the already closed broad APR/BLU literature passes without a new artifact. This preference rests on a newly identified, decision-changing asset family, not an exemption from pricing or rights requirements.
cross_portfolio_decision.comparable_functional_commitment: APR has same-disease human observations and a locally delivered historical article. BLU has a more concrete post-deficit human-force qualification route. FD-2 presently lacks a patient-derived mature functional route and exposure package; PSB lacks a verified mature-human-force bridge and capturable contribution; CuNC needs a current-comparator incremental-benefit claim. These substantive differences favor evaluating APR/BLU's already specified functional scopes before an unbounded new program.
cross_portfolio_decision.symmetric_burden: No current quote, available license, achieved exposure or executed transfer is presumed for either incumbent or new lead. An actual bounded FD-2/PSB offer can outrank an APR/BLU offer if it buys more consequential information and retained value at its actual remaining cost.
cross_portfolio_decision.stop_condition: Once the named public records have been reconciled, stop repetitive searches and recompare only on a new substantive article, access, product, rights or priced-scope artifact.

records.name: PSB-KD107 for Duchenne muscular dystrophy
records.exact_use: A defined GPR18 agonist to improve skeletal-muscle function and regenerative response in DMD.
records.asset_limit: The paper names a purchased research compound. No authenticated current lot, muscle-exposure specification, finished clinical product, commercial license or live stock/price is established.
records.disposition: Conditional information reserve; short capture/specification gate before a broader translational program.
records.evidence_level: One peer-reviewed preclinical investigator lineage with mdx mouse muscle force and dystrophic human iPSC myogenic observations.

evidence_units.unit: Male mdx mice beginning at ten weeks of age
evidence_units.endpoint: Absolute and specific ex-vivo EDL force after a three-week treatment period.
evidence_units.denominator: Figure caption reports five animals per group, except the O-1602 comparator with three.
evidence_units.interpretation: Treatment begins after early disease onset; baseline force was not documented within each animal, and advanced-stage reversal was not established.

evidence_units.denominator: Three donor lines: two DMD and one Becker muscular dystrophy.
evidence_units.interpretation: Do not call these three DMD patients or patient muscle-force rescue. Repeated measurements and technical duplicate receptor assays are not donors.

evidence_units.denominator: Three independent animals reported for the cell experiments.
evidence_units.interpretation: Supports myogenic biology, not a second independent drug-development study.

positive_evidence: The mdx force result measures useful organ function rather than only a biomarker.
The active proresolving comparator RvD2 also improved force; GPR55 agonist O-1602 did not show a significant force effect in its smaller group.
Dystrophic human cell fusion and inflammatory/fibrotic findings are directionally supportive.
negative_or_limiting_evidence: Human-cell evidence is a differentiation/fusion endpoint, not mature contractile output.
Diaphragm fibrosis improvement is not a demonstrated respiratory, cardiac or survival benefit.
No current-care add-on or active glucocorticoid comparison establishes incremental DMD benefit.
The tested mouse administration does not establish practical chronic human delivery, relevant free muscle exposure or an adequate therapeutic window.
No independent replication or human therapeutic result is established.

rights_and_capture.observed: The primary article identifies Cayman as research supplier. Search recovered the exact Cayman item 31393; live primary catalog retrieval returned HTTP 403. No specific obtainable commercial interest or exact use/compound patent family was verified in the bounded search.
rights_and_capture.capture_inference: A defined, historically supplied small molecule could reduce article reconstruction effort. Its old public disclosure and unverified proprietary contribution weaken a standalone asset thesis; research supply does not grant commercial rights.
unresolved: Exact identity and currently obtainable specification
Existing composition/use rights and current ownership
A useful differentiated product or contractual data/option contribution
DMD incremental value relative to relevant care

records.financing_scope: Potential bounded research-article/exposure and mature-muscle function qualification, then a separately evaluated chronic DMD development program. No actual price or schedule is supplied.
records.cheapest_next_information_gate: Use the exact article record, public compound/use claims and existing exposure information to decide whether a defensible, obtainable contribution and a practical chronic product are plausible. If so, scope a mature human-muscle function question and its relevant-care comparator; do not treat fusion as that result.
records.stopping_rule: Stop the standalone commercial thesis if the only contribution is repeating a published generic research effect with no retainable downstream value. Hold if useful mature force cannot be separated from nonspecific differentiation or if necessary exposure/product work becomes an open-ended chemistry program. A prevention-limited effect should be re-scoped to a feasible treatment window, not automatically rejected.
records.comparison_to_apr_blu: PSB offers clearer published mouse-force evidence and a historical exact supplier, reducing some identity uncertainty relative to BLU reconstruction. BLU nevertheless has a more concretely specified post-deficit human-force route; PSB still needs that bridge and a stronger capture thesis. APR's same-disease clinical signal/local article supports a more direct intended-use question. These are substantive scope comparisons, not a penalty applied only to PSB for missing prices.

records.name: FD-2 peptide for ALS
records.exact_use: A defined extracellular Pgk1-derived peptide to preserve motor-neuron and neuromuscular function in ALS; FD-2 selected, with FD-1 retained as an informative comparator.
records.asset_limit: The paper defines the active peptide family and a single-residue FD-2 variant. The patent explicitly names FD2. Final chemical-form/terminus correspondence, lot specification, measured exposure and current commercial rights are not independently established.
records.disposition: First bounded information gate in this lane: reconcile the newly located peptide patent, article identity and existing product/exposure record.
records.evidence_level: One investigator lineage spanning engineered cell models, developmental fish models and presymptomatically treated SOD1-G93A mice; a related patent is not independent confirmation.

evidence_units.denominator: Cells and repeated experiments do not constitute patient donors.
evidence_units.interpretation: No patient-derived human neuronal functional rescue in this paper.

evidence_units.unit: Developmental zebrafish C9orf72 knockdown and hTDP43-G348C models
evidence_units.denominator: Separate model experiments within the same publication lineage.
evidence_units.interpretation: Not adult genetic-patient replication or evidence for all ALS genotypes.

evidence_units.endpoint: Grip/locomotion, NMJ integrity, motor-neuron markers and time to humane endpoint.
evidence_units.denominator: Five animals per group for grip/locomotion; twelve per group for survival; repeated grip readings are not independent animals.
evidence_units.interpretation: Treatment starts at postnatal day 60 before overt decline. Endpoint includes inability to feed with forelimb paralysis, not observed natural lifespan. The report describes random assignment and blinded endpoint assessment.

evidence_units.denominator: Patent survival counts differ from the later article (control seven, treated groups five).
evidence_units.interpretation: Same investigator/asset lineage; overlap is unresolved. Do not sum or call independent replication.

positive_evidence: Useful motor outcomes and time to humane endpoint improve in a mammalian ALS model.
FD-2 appears stronger in vivo than FD-1 in the paper, while FD-1 is stronger in some cell comparisons; this creates a discriminating within-family comparator.
A specific institutional patent family supplies a plausible route to an asset relationship, rather than an anonymous target-only concept.
negative_or_limiting_evidence: No verified post-symptomatic rescue; existing evidence most directly supports early preservation or delay.
Patient-derived mature motor-unit function and broad genetic applicability are unproven.
Measured systemic/tissue pharmacokinetics, relevant exposure duration, immunogenicity and a chronic product package were not established.
The proposed conformational/stability explanation for FD-2's relative in-vivo advantage is a hypothesis, not measured pharmacokinetic superiority.
Full-length extracellular Pgk1, intracellular Pgk1 enzyme enhancement and FD-2 are distinct interventions; their results cannot be pooled as exact-article replication.

rights_and_capture.observed: US20240327462A1, published 2024-10-03, explicitly describes FD peptides and lists Mackay Medical College and Fu Jen Catholic University. Its indexed US status is pending; this is a third-party transcription of a primary patent publication, not verified current official prosecution or title. The paper's no-conflict statement does not negate the filing.
rights_and_capture.capture_inference: A defined peptide plus institutional claims is a plausible license/option or evidence-rights contribution, but no willingness to transact, clean title, exact claim match or economic terms is established.
unresolved: Exact final peptide and terminal-form correspondence between article and claims
Current territorial claims and title/license encumbrances
What existing exposure/product data can be used
A retainable contribution and access terms

records.financing_scope: First a finite document/product-rights reconciliation. A later systemic peptide and disease-functional qualification project has separate exposure, model and formulation dependencies; no low-cost peptide-development assumption or dollar quote is invented.
records.cheapest_next_information_gate: Reconcile the final article's FD-2 identity and endpoint units with the named patent examples/claims, current public national records and any existing product/exposure information. Specify whether the next useful question concerns early prevention in a feasible diagnosed population or later symptomatic function, and whether it can be answered through an obtainable bounded evidence route.
records.stopping_rule: Close this public-record pass when the named identity/claim and existing-data questions are resolved or accessible records are exhausted. Hold if an exact peptide/product cannot be specified, or if the next informative step requires broad delivery discovery and a new model platform without a superior incremental-value case. Re-scope a prevention-only benefit to a feasible population/window before comparing costs; prevention alone is not failure. A private owner response is not a prerequisite for scientific selection.
records.comparison_to_apr_blu: Prefer this newly opened article/patent reconciliation over another unchanged APR/BLU broad literature pass. For an actual functional commitment, APR has same-disease human observations and a local article, while BLU has a defined post-deficit human-force route; FD-2 lacks a mature patient-derived functional route and measured exposure. FD-2 can still become the better conditional next information dollar if its actual available scope is narrower, more discriminating or retains more value; apply identical price/rights burdens to all.

records.name: Defined copper nanoclusters for Menkes disease
records.exact_use: Defined stabilized copper nanoclusters for early ATP7A-deficient Menkes disease, seeking useful neurological or product benefit beyond copper histidinate.
records.asset_limit: The publication characterizes defined formulations, but the exact development variant, reproducible released batch, chronic product specification and commercial rights are not established.
records.disposition: Conditional translational/partner reserve; existing-data comparator and product-rights audit only.
records.evidence_level: One primary Mo-blo mouse study lineage, with formulation characterization, survival and selected later functional observations; no CuNC patient efficacy.

evidence_units.unit: Mo-blo ATP7A-deficient mice treated from postnatal day five
evidence_units.endpoint: Survival through postnatal day 50 against untreated, copper-histidine and wild-type groups.
evidence_units.interpretation: Severe early death includes vascular/aortic disease. The reported 50-day value coincides with the study endpoint and must not be presented as independently established median lifespan.

evidence_units.denominator: Predominantly treated survivors compared with wild-type; few surviving disease controls.
evidence_units.interpretation: Survivor selection and missing comparable untreated/CuHis groups prevent a clean causal claim of neurological normalization. Treated animals retain significantly more stumbles than wild-type.

evidence_units.endpoint: Cuproenzyme activity, organ markers and histology.
evidence_units.denominator: Age/survival strata differ; some late CuHis samples have only two or three animals.
evidence_units.interpretation: Elevated ALT and beta-2-microglobulin deserve attention. A claimed adaptive/reversible explanation is not verified longitudinal reversal; normal histology or negative staining does not establish complete safety.

evidence_units.endpoint: FDA survival assessment from two single-arm clinical studies with external controls.
evidence_units.denominator: 66 treated participants and 17 untreated contemporary external controls overall.
evidence_units.interpretation: Different human comparator evidence; not randomized, not CuNC evidence and not proof of neurological equivalence.

positive_evidence: A defined formulation improves early survival against the study's copper-histidine comparator in a severe ATP7A-deficient mouse model.
Brain cuproenzyme activity and later behavioral observations support investigating a neurological contribution.
A named university/hospital patent family offers a plausible translation/partner route.
negative_or_limiting_evidence: A study endpoint at day 50 cannot establish 50-day median lifespan for a group with survivors at the boundary.
Later behavioral comparisons are subject to differential survival and are not a robust matched surviving-disease-control demonstration.
Residual coordination deficits remain; nonsignificance versus wild-type is not equivalence.
Reported biochemical safety abnormalities are not neutralized by qualitative histology or an untested reversibility explanation.
FDA-approved copper histidinate now supplies a survival-benefit baseline; untreated-only need cannot define the incremental product claim.
Early neonatal treatment does not establish treatment of later irreversible neurological damage.

rights_and_capture.observed: WO2022238656A1, published 2022-11-17, names University of Lorraine and CHU Nancy in the indexed record and describes copper nanocluster/Menkes uses. The WO indexed status is ceased while national family entries remain; this does not establish family abandonment. Current official national prosecution, title and available license are not verified.
rights_and_capture.capture_inference: This is an institutional formulation-development opportunity, not unowned generic copper. A reproducible manufacturing/product contribution and incremental advantage over approved therapy could retain value, but neither is established as an offered transaction.
unresolved: Exact candidate formulation and released product specification
Current territorial rights and license availability
Survival censoring and survivor-stratified functional evidence
Incremental neurological, delivery or safety benefit versus approved copper histidinate

records.financing_scope: Finite existing-data and product/rights audit first. Full nanomedicine manufacturing, chronic safety and pediatric clinical development would be a materially larger program than a small model-qualification tranche; no numerical budget is asserted.
records.cheapest_next_information_gate: Reconcile survival censoring, age/selection strata and the exact formulation-to-patent relationship, then state a testable incremental claim against current copper histidinate. Determine whether existing data distinguish brain-function or product benefit beyond systemic survival; stop if they only support the already-satisfied untreated comparison.
records.stopping_rule: Hold broad brain-restoration claims if surviving-control comparisons cannot distinguish treatment from survival selection. Re-scope to a narrower systemic or practical product benefit only if it remains clinically consequential against approved copper histidinate. Hold development if reliable formulation control or an obtainable value contribution remains undefined. A feasible neonatal-prevention window is acceptable and does not require adult reversal.
records.comparison_to_apr_blu: The existing-data survival/comparator audit is inexpensive in kind and consequential, but it is a different purchase from APR/BLU useful-function qualification. A chronic pediatric nanomedicine program has more manufacturing and comparator dependencies. No higher funded rank is justified by the large untreated-mouse effect alone; an actual narrow data/option package could still be worth comparing on equal terms.

prior_related_inventory.name: Copper-ionophore formulation for ATP7A deficiency
prior_related_inventory.adjudication: Same disease and copper-delivery purpose were already encountered. The two historical primary links describe elesclomol-copper; the selected CuNC@HisAc/HisAcAsc is a different exact formulation/article. Do not count a new disease or transfer the prior two-child report into CuNC evidence.

records.novelty_scope: Scoped new exact formulation/use against the 424-file baseline and 13 recovered reports; prior Menkes P010 is retained as a different-article concept. Screens N–Q remain unrecovered.

rejects.name: Cyclo(His-Pro) for DMD
rejects.disposition: Partnered/sponsor program scout; not retained as a standalone new development asset.
rejects.useful_signal: Mouse grip/hanging function and preventive-cohort ex-vivo force improve; a later-start cohort is also reported.
rejects.limiting_evidence: No endurance or eccentric-injury protection and no CK improvement. Ex-vivo force evidence from the preventive cohort cannot simply be assigned to the later-start cohort; no human DMD functional result.
rejects.rights: NovMetaPharma funding and company-affiliated coauthors; WO2025127437A1 is assigned in the index to Novmetapharma and explicitly addresses muscle-function/disease use. No license offer or current enforceability determination established.
rejects.reason: A potentially useful competitor/partner rather than a generic untouched molecule; its mechanism and incremental DMD contribution do not presently beat the retained finite information gates.
rejects.future_trigger: A distinct obtainable partnership/product contribution or independent clinically relevant functional/exposure evidence.

rejects.name: GBT601 plus PT2399 for NDUFS4-related Leigh disease
rejects.disposition: Strong functional science; partnered/rights-complex reserve, not retained for an independent small next development tranche.
rejects.useful_signal: The paper reports late-treatment Ndufs4-knockout motor/survival benefit, including combination benefit after advanced disease. This is stronger timing evidence than the preventive FD-2/CuNC studies.
rejects.limiting_evidence: Systemic oxygen-affinity/HIF-2 physiology introduces a distinct translation and safety problem. The separate Friedreich model improved motor trajectories without lifespan or cardiac rescue. Voxelotor withdrawal is a related-class caution, not an exact GBT601-Leigh failure.
rejects.rights: Paper discloses MGH hypoxia-related patent interests and relevant author company equity; GBT601 belongs to an existing industry asset lineage. Current exact trial status, available rights and a combined-product offer were not established.
rejects.reason: Do not downgrade the functional signal to justify a preferred list. The existing candidate/combination and interdependent systemic physiology currently imply a larger partnered program than the chosen document-level asset gates.
rejects.future_trigger: An obtainable scoped collaboration or product contribution, exact current asset status, and an interpretable relevant-exposure safety/benefit package.
rejects.lineage: Preprint and PNAS paper are the same study lineage, not two replications. The bounded search did not substantiate a claim that GBT601 is discontinued.

rejects.name: Nifuroxazide for CHCHD10-S59L disease
rejects.useful_signal: Patient fibroblast and patient-derived motor-neuron mitochondrial morphology/motility and stress-associated survival observations.
rejects.limiting_evidence: No organism motor function or mature neuromuscular output in the retrieved study. MICOS-complex stability was not restored. MIC13/QIL1-cell findings are narrower network readouts, not demonstrated cross-disease cristae rescue.
rejects.rights: The primary paper reports PCT/EP2022/083829 filed 2022-11-30. Generic drug access and a no-conflict declaration do not establish an unencumbered neurological product. Relevant exposure was not verified.
rejects.reason: Subcellular/cell-survival restoration has a less direct useful-function bridge than retained mammalian functional assets, with exposure and product capture still unresolved.
rejects.future_trigger: Independent organism or patient-derived mature functional benefit at relevant exposure plus an obtainable differentiated contribution.
